verses.sanskrit:
धृतराष्ट्र उवाच।
              क्षत्रतेजा ब्रह्मचारी कौमारादपि पाण्डवः। तेन संयुगमेष्यन्ति मन्दा विलपतो मम ॥१॥
verses.english: Dhritarashtra said The son of Pandu, from his youth, has the prowess of a Kshatriya and leads the life of a Brahmachari. Those fools desire to fight with him, thought I am lamenting.

verses.sanskrit: दुर्योधन निवर्तस्व युद्धाद्भरतसत्तम। न हि युद्धं प्रशंसन्ति सर्वावस्थमरिन्दम ॥२॥
verses.english: O Duryodhana, O you best among the race of Bharata, turn your mind away from fight; war is not desirable under all conditions, O you subduer of enemies.

verses.sanskrit: अलमर्धं पृथिव्यास्ते सहामात्यस्य जीवितुम्। प्रयच्छ पाण्डुपुत्राणां यथोचितमरिन्दम ॥३॥
verses.english: One half of the earth is sufficient for the livelihood of yourself and your ministers. Give back to the sons of Pandu their dues, O you subduer of enemies.

verses.sanskrit: एतद्धि कुरवः सर्वे मन्यन्ते धर्मसंहितम्। यत्त्वं प्रशान्तिं मन्येथाः पाण्डुपुत्रैर्महात्मभिः ॥४। अङ्गेमां समवेक्षस्व पुत्र स्वामेव वाहिनीम्। जात एष तवाभावस्त्वं तु मोहान्न बुध्यसे ॥५॥
verses.english: Think well, O son, of the elements of your own army; it has been collected for your own death; you do not accept this out of folly.

verses.sanskrit: न त्वहं युद्धमिच्छामि नैतदिच्छति बाह्लिकः। न च भीष्मो न च द्रोणो नाश्वत्थामा न सञ्जयः ॥६॥
verses.english: I do not wish war; nor is Balhika desirous of it; nor is Bhishma; nor is Drona, nor is Ashvathama; nor is Sanjaya nor Somadatta, nor Shala, nor Kripa desire war; nor does Satyavrata, nor Purumitra, nor Jaya, nor Bhurishravas.
verses.bhavadeepa: जात एष तवाभाव इत्यत्र शम एव महच्छ्रेय इत्याधुनिकः पाठः । तराभ्याव इति पाठे तराणामश्वादीनां वेगवतां वाहनानामभ्यावः सर्वतः खादनं कण्डूरोगाद्युपद्रव इति यावत् । अव -रक्षणगतिकान्तीत्यादेः खादनार्थात् घञ् । आस्राव इति पाठे आस्त्रावः क्षतं यानेषूपद्रवः पराजयलक्षणमिति भावः ॥५॥

verses.sanskrit: न सोमदत्तो न शलो न कृपो युद्धमिच्छति। सत्यव्रतः पुरुमित्रो जयो भूरिश्रवास्तथा ॥७॥
येषु संप्रतितिष्ठेयुः कुरवः पीडिताः परैः। ते युद्धं नाभिनन्दन्ति तत्तुभ्यं तात रोचताम् ॥८॥
verses.english: Those on whom depend the Kurus, when troubled by the enemy not rejoice at the prospect of war; O dear, may you accept that.

verses.sanskrit: न त्वं करोषि कामेन कर्णः कारयिता तव। दुःशासनश्च पापात्मा शकुनिश्चापि सौबलः ॥९॥
verses.english: You do not act in this way of your own will; but Karna leads you to it and Dushasana and the wicked-souled Shakuni and the son of Subala (lead you).

verses.sanskrit:
दुर्योधन उवाच।
              नाहं भवति न द्रोणे नाश्वत्थाम्नि न सञ्जये। न भीष्मे न च काम्बोजे न कृपे न च बाह्लिके ॥१०॥
verses.english: Duryodhana said I do not depend on Drona or Ashvathama or Sanjaya or Bhishma or Kamboja or Kripa or Balhika or Satyavrata or Purumitra or on Bhurishravas, nor do I challenge them to fight, depending on others.

verses.sanskrit: सत्यव्रते पुरुमित्रे भूरिश्रवसि वा पुनः। अन्येषु वा तावकेषु भारं कृत्वा समाह्वयम् ॥११॥
अहं च तात कर्णश्च रणयज्ञं वितत्य वै। युधिष्ठिरं पशुं कृत्वा दीक्षितौ भरतर्षभ ॥१२॥
verses.english: O Sire, I and Karna will perform the sacrifice of war after preparing ourselves, making Yudhishthira the beast for sacrifice.

verses.sanskrit: रथो वेदी स्रुवः खड्गो गदास्रुक् कवचं सदः। चातुर्होत्रं च धुर्या मे शरा दर्भा हविर्यशः ॥१३॥
verses.english: In the ceremony my car will be the substitute for the platform; my scimitar, the ladle; my mace, the large ladle; and my coat of mail, the witnesses; my horses will answer the purpose of the four priests; my rafts will stand for the Kusha grass; and my fame, for the clarified butter.

verses.sanskrit: आत्मयज्ञेन नृपते इष्ट्वा वैवस्वतं रणे। विजित्य च समेष्यावो हतामित्रौ श्रिया वृतौ ॥१४॥
verses.english: Having performed, O king, this sacrifice in the field of battle, in honour of the God of death, by ourselves and having won a victory and slain our enemies, we shall come back surrounded by a halo of glory.

verses.sanskrit: अहं च तात कर्णश्च भ्राता दुःशासनश्च मे। एते वयं हनिष्यामः पाण्डवान् समरे त्रयः ॥१५॥
verses.english: Myself, O Sire, Karna and my brother Dushasana, these three of us will kill the sons of Pandu in battle.

verses.sanskrit: अहं हि पाण्डवान् हत्वा प्रशास्ता पृथिवीमिमाम्। मां वा हत्वा पाण्डुपुत्रा भोक्तारः पृथिवीमिमाम् ॥१६॥
verses.english: Either I shall rule this earth, having slain the sons of Pandu; or the sons of Pandu will enjoy sovereignty over this earth after having slain me.

verses.sanskrit: त्यक्तं मे जीवितं राज्यं धनं सर्वं च पार्थिव। न जातु पाण्डवैः सार्धं वसेयमहमच्युत ॥१७॥
verses.english: I can sacrifice my life, my kingdom, my wealth, my everything, O king; but I cannot live in peace with the sons of Pandu, O you of unfading renown.

verses.sanskrit: यावद्धि सूच्यास्तीक्ष्णाया विध्येदग्रेण मारिष। तावदप्यपरित्याज्यं भूमेर्नः पाण्डवान् प्रति ॥१८॥
verses.english: That extent of land which is pierced by the extremity of a sharp needle, O venerable Sire, I shall not surrender to the sons of Pandu.

verses.sanskrit:
धृतराष्ट्र उवाच।
              सर्वान् वस्तात शोचामि त्यक्तो दुर्योधनो मया। ये मन्दमनुयास्यध्वं यान्तं वैवस्वतक्षयम् ॥१९॥
verses.english: Dhritarashtra said I grieve for you all, O rulers, who are following that fool to the abode of the king of death; but Duryodhana is cast off by me forever.

verses.sanskrit: रुरूणामिव यूथेषु व्याघ्राः प्रहरतां वराः। वरान् वरान् हनिष्यन्ति समेता युधि पाण्डवाः ॥२०॥
verses.english: Like tigers in a herd of deer these foremost of strikers, those Pandavas assembled together will kill the principal warriors in battle.

verses.sanskrit: प्रतीपमिव मे भाति युयुधानेन भारती। व्यस्ता सीमन्तिनी ग्रस्ता प्रमृष्टा दीर्घबाहुना ॥२१॥
verses.english: The army of the Bharatas appears to me as already fallen down like a woman troubled and afflicted and struck by one of the long arms.
verses.bhavadeepa: रुरूणामिवेत्यत्र कुरूणां लाटभाषया । अजानामिति पाठो युक्तः । पक्षे कुरूणां मध्ये वरान् वरान् व्याघ्रा इवेति योजना ॥२०॥

verses.sanskrit: संपूर्णं पूरयन् भूयो धनं पार्थस्य माधवः। शैनेयः समरे स्थाता बीजवत् प्रवपन् शरान् ॥२२॥
verses.english: Increasing in strength, what was already full, viz., Yudhishthira's army the son of Shini will stand on the field shooting arrows as one sows the seeds.

verses.sanskrit: सेनामुखे प्रयुद्धानां भीमसेनो भविष्यति। तं सर्वे संश्रयिप्यन्ति प्राकारमकुतोभयम् ॥२३॥
verses.english: In front of the fighting soldiers Bhimasena will stand and all will be shatered behind him as behind a strong wall, fearlessly.

verses.sanskrit: यदा द्रक्ष्यसि भीमेन कुञ्जरान् विनिपातितान्। विशीर्णदन्तान् गिर्याभान्भिन्नकुभान्सशोणितान् ॥२४॥
verses.english: When you will see your elephants, big as mountains, felled down by Bhima with their tusks broken and with blood flowing resembling a broken pot (with water flowing).

verses.sanskrit: तानभिप्रेक्ष्य सङ्ग्रामे विशीर्णानिव पर्वतान्। भीतो भीमस्य संस्पर्शात् स्मर्ताऽसि वचनस्य मे ॥२५॥
verses.english: Beholding them in the field of battle like mountains separated and struck with fear by coming in contract with Bhima, then will you remember my words.

verses.sanskrit: निर्दग्धं भीमसेनेन सैन्यं रथ-हय-द्विपम्। गतिमग्नेरिव प्रेक्ष्य स्मर्ताऽसि वचनस्य मे ॥२६॥
verses.english: Beholding your army composed of chariot, horses and elephants burnt up as it were by Bhimasena like the path followed by a fire, will you remember my words.

verses.sanskrit: महद्वो भयमागामि न चेच्छाम्यथ पाण्डवैः। गदया भीमसेनेन हताः शममुपैष्यथ ॥२७॥
verses.english: A heavy calamity will you meet, if you do not conclude peace with the Pandavas. Killed by Bhimasena with his mace, will you ever remain in peace.

verses.sanskrit: महावनमिव च्छिन्नं यदा द्रक्ष्यसि पातितम्। बलं कुरूणां भीमेन तदा स्मर्ताऽसि मे वचः ॥२८॥
verses.english: When you will see the army of the Kurus, felled down by Bhima like a large forest torn off, then will you remember my words.

verses.sanskrit:
वैशम्पायन उवाच।
              एतावदुक्त्वा राजा तु सर्वांस्तान् पृथिवीपतीन्। अनुभाष्य महाराज पुनः पप्रच्छ सञ्जयम् ॥२९॥
verses.english: Vaishampayana said Having said this to all those rulers of the earth, the king, O great king, addressing Sanjaya asked him.
